measurement: The Vista CTO4 is a universal fit device. No circumference measurement is required. This prefabricated orthosis is intended to be customized to the individual patient by a qualified healthcare practitioner as directed by a physician. Anterior panel adjusts to 6 height levels (Level 1 is lowest) to ensure neutral positioning. Posterior panel adjusts to 3 height levels (Level 1 is lowest) to ensure occipital contact for proper motion restriction. Flexible Thoracic Adjustment accommodates essentially all patient anatomies. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
